verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents that databases have available regions you can list, plus configurable Vitess read-only regions. It also offers bring-your-own-cloud via PlanetScale Managed, which implies control over data location. However, the evidence never explicitly documents choosing a primary region at database creation or any data-residency guarantees. missing for 10: explicit docs on selecting a primary region at creation, documented residency/compliance commitments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can now list the regions available to a database, and list configured Vitess read-only regions for the database's default branch.
including bring your own cloud with [PlanetScale Managed](/docs/plans/managed)
